My dear [Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1301),

Could you be so kind as first to send on a card the name of anyone to write to at Freshwater about lodgings for a fortnight or so, or if that great Alum bay hotel is thought well of.[^1] [Mrs Elgie](../persons.html#474)[^2] wants a little airing after her winter of illness, and I fancy Bonchurch would be too relaxing for her, but if there are any lodgings anywhere you specially recommend it would be a kindness to mention them, and the sort of rate of price.

It is only [Mr](../persons.html#478) and Mrs Elgie, not the children.

If you are gone from home, perhaps one of your sisters would be so kind as to set down particulars.

Yours sincerely,

C M Yonge

[^1]: Perhaps the Royal Needles Hotel, Alum Bay, from which Marconi sent the first wireless transmission in 1897.

[^2]: Catharine Elgie, wife of the curate of Otterbourne.
